title: Three Weeks and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：mail　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mail 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the postman ① sent the mail that no sender in the office would have recorded, and he said the sending was the whole of the week. The ② mail, meaning the post itself and not the stamp, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; mail, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ item of mail in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ mail at the far box, meaning the parcel they kept for the children to fetch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Mail, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the postman said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the mail was the whole of the matter, meaning the news and not the post. The ⑥ mail, meaning the news and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; mail, he said, is either something you send or the only word that means both post and a news. He said the news is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ mail had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ mail of the whole thing, the postman wrote in May, was one office and three weeks of recording; mail, he said, is either the parcel at the far box or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ mail I remember is the mail recorded in the list, which closed in 1973 and is still recorded as the quietest in the office. ⑩ Mail, my mother said in 1975, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all mail, she said, is a news that has agreed to look like post. She said the news was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 邮件；信件（指邮局里每一件旁边的那一件）
B. n. 邮件；信件（指那封邮件本身，与邮票相对）
C. 固定搭配：send the mail 寄出这封邮件
D. n. 邮件；信件（指留给孩子们取的那一件那一封）
E. n. 通邮之事（抽象总称，指一处邮局的邮件之事）
F. n. 邮件；信件（指收发清单里写到、被登记的的那一封）
G. n. 消息、音信（指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 音信（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: sent the mail that no sender in the office would have recorded
The mail, meaning the post itself and not the stamp
Every item of mail in that office
the mail at the far box
the mail was the whole of the matter
the mail had become a line in a list
The mail of the whole thing

answers.why: send the mail 意为“寄出这封邮件”，1966 年那位邮差把邮局里没有一位寄信人肯登记的一封邮件做了一遍。
mail 意为“邮件；信件”，指那封邮件本身而不是邮票，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被登记。
mail 意为“邮件；信件”，指邮局里每一件旁边的那一件，每一件旁边都有同一枚小小的邮票。
mail 意为“邮件；信件”，指最远那只信箱留给孩子们取的那一件那一封，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
mail 意为“消息、音信”，指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个消息就是那件事的全部。
mail 意为“音信”，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西而不是那封邮件，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
mail 意为“邮件；信件”，指收发清单里写到、被登记的的那一封，到 1971 年这一封成了收发清单里的一行。
mail 意为“通邮之事”，邮差五月写道，整件事的邮件之事是一处邮局和三个星期的登记。
mail 意为“邮件；信件”，我记得的是收发清单里登记过的那一封，1973 年送完了，至今仍被说成邮局里最安静的一封。
mail 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，邮件是唯一会因为被好好登记而变得更好的邮件。
